summary: Baker Mayfield (thumb) is out, so rookie Jalon Daniels makes his second start for winless Tampa at Dallas (DAL around -8.5, total 47.5); Tampa is also missing safety Winfield and corner Morrison, while Dallas lists WR Mingo as questionable with illness.

best.why: In Daniels' first start, Godwin was his safety valve with six catches on seven targets, and Tampa should again rely on short throws while trailing by more than a touchdown. Dallas allows the league's worst success rate on dropbacks, and Godwin has gone over this line in six of his last 10 games.

NFL|00-0033921|rec.note: Rookie Jalon Daniels starts for Mayfield (thumb) and fed Godwin seven short targets last week; Dallas allows the league's worst dropback success rate and Tampa likely trails by 8.5.

NFL|00-0033921|recyd.note: Volume should be there as Daniels' safety valve, but his targets came near the line of scrimmage, which caps yards per catch.

NFL|00-0040129|recyd.note: Backup QB Daniels has not pushed the ball downfield, and Egbuka was largely quiet in his first start.
